name: @buildapp/evidence-pack
description: The Analyzer Evidence Pack (BUILDPLAN-ANALYZER-005D): what one analyzer run saw, inferred, weighed, accepted and rejected, as analyzer-owned SVG primitives with JSON sidecars, a decision timeline, a manifest and a first-divergence helper. Built after a run from what the run wrote, so it can change nothing the run decided. Pure and browser-safe; never embeds a publisher's pixels.
